test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Wily
solution:
The correct option is **Honest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A word that has the **opposite meaning** from another word is called an **antonym**.
 
• **Wily** is an **adjective** that denotes intelligence, a keen awareness of people, possibilities, and circumstances, and a propensity for deceit. Basically **wily** means clever.
 
 
• ​***Example : **Ramesh is a **wily** politician.*
 
 

 
• When you say someone is **honest**, you're referring to the fact that they always tell the truth and don't try to trick others or breach the law.
 
• We can say that honest is the opposite word of Wily.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first option **horrid** means unpleasant or unkind. 

 
 
• ***Example: ****He's a horrid little man*
 
 
 
• **Raunchy** refers to something that is inextricably linked to sex.
 
 
• ***Example :** It was a raunchy film .*
 
 
 
• **Triumphant** refers to having gained triumph or victory.
 
 
• ***Example :** Danial and his triumphant soldiers celebrate their victory .*
 
 
 
• Above three options are not the opposite word of Wily. So the opposite word of wily is **Honest** .
